fusions.name: Dead Still Shot
fusions.desc: A shot that deals 32 damage and freezes the target [Frozen] for 1.5 seconds. Every hit is a critical hit.

fusions.name: Chill Sweep
fusions.desc: Sweeps a ring of cold that deals 8 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and leaves it [Slowed] for 2 seconds. Holds 4 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Hold Still
fusions.desc: For 4 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you. Transcendent damage still lands. Your movement speed rises 20% for 3 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Sunlit Reset
fusions.desc: When your stamina runs out, you restore 3 stamina a second for 6 seconds. Once every 20 seconds.
